purpose: Semantic supervision for prompt-guided multiplex virtual staining. Each record describes one subcellular structure symbolically; for the test fields no pixel-aligned target exists.

nuclear_frame.description: Every cell of a field is represented by its nucleus: centroid (cy, cx) in pixel coordinates, semi-minor radius r (px), elongation e = semi-major / semi-minor, and major-axis angle theta (radians, measured from the +x axis towards +y).
nuclear_frame.coordinates: u = (x-cx)*cos(theta) + (y-cy)*sin(theta); v = -(x-cx)*sin(theta) + (y-cy)*cos(theta); rho = sqrt((u/(r*e))^2 + (v/r)^2). rho = 0 is the nuclear centre, rho = 1 the nuclear envelope, u runs along the major axis.
nuclear_frame.composition: Every nucleus of the field contributes independently and the contributions are summed (linear superposition, no normalisation, no clipping between cells).

actin.prompt: filamentous actin: a dense cortical band that follows the cell periphery, plus long stress fibres running parallel to the nucleus major axis.

components.name: stress_fibres
components.form: Gaussian ridge in v multiplied by a Gaussian taper along u

tubulin.prompt: microtubules: a perinuclear basket plus thin filaments radiating outwards from the nucleus.

components.name: radiating_filaments
components.form: for m = 0..8 an anisotropic Gaussian centred at distance 1.30*r from the nuclear centre along the direction phi_m = theta + 2*pi*m/9 + 0.13*m, with long-axis half-length 0.95*r*e (along phi_m), short-axis half-width 0.15*r, and Gaussian (not truncated) profile in both directions

mito.prompt: mitochondria: a broad perinuclear reticulum decorated with discrete puncta.

components.name: puncta
components.form: isotropic Gaussian of sigma 0.85 px, placed on the hexagonal lattice uu = 0.55*i + 0.275*(j mod 2), vv = 0.42*j (Python modulo) for all integers i, j in [-3, 3] whose normalised lattice radius sqrt(uu^2 + vv^2) lies strictly between 1.05 and 1.85; the pixel offset of the punctum from the nuclear centre is (uu*r*e, vv*r) along (x, y)

golgi.prompt: Golgi apparatus: a compact ribbon on one side of the nucleus, polarised along the nucleus minor axis.

components.name: ribbon
components.form: radial Gaussian in rho multiplied by the logistic gate 1/(1+exp(-v/(0.35*r)))

er.prompt: endoplasmic reticulum: a reticular mesh filling the cytoplasm around the nucleus.

components.name: reticular_envelope
components.form: 0.85 * (radial Gaussian in rho with centre_rho 1.35 and sigma_rho 0.45) * (0.75 + 0.50 * mesh), where mesh = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(6*u/(r*e))*sin(5*v/r)

intensity: Absolute grey levels are deliberately NOT part of the prompt. Calibrate each channel against /app/data/train so that the rendered signal reproduces the grey-level distribution of that channel inside the evaluation mask of protocol.md (at least the 50th and 95th percentiles), including the constant background level.
weak_supervision_note: In the original framework these prompts replace pixel-aligned multiplex targets. Only the DNA channel of a test field is observed; the other five structures have to be synthesised from the prompt alone.
